description: This file contains the implementation of the NoteService class, which handles business logic for notes in a note management system. It manages operations such as creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, enforcing ownership and mapping data models to response DTOs.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Implements INoteService interface, providing methods for note management including creation, retrieval, update, and deletion, with ownership validation and mapping functionalities.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new note for the specified user, saves it to the repository, and returns the created note as a DTO.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all notes belonging to a specific user, returning a list of DTOs.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by ID for a user, returning the note DTO or null if not found.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing note's details if it exists and belongs to the user, returning the updated note DTO or null if not found.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a note if it exists and belongs to the user, returning a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Converts a Note entity to a NoteResponse DTO.
